description:
## [1.3.0](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-06)

### 🔒 Security

* **Your saved password is never shown again.** Once a password is saved in Proxy settings, the field stays empty and says **"(password saved — type to replace)"**.
  * Leave it empty to keep the saved password, or type a new one to replace it.
  * **Remove saved password** clears it (the field then says "(will be removed when you save)").
  * **Test connection** still uses the saved password when the field is empty.
  * "Show password" became **"Show typed password"**, so it only reveals what you've just typed, never the saved one.
  * Before this, anyone holding your unlocked phone could open Proxy settings, tap "Show password", and read it.
* **No screenshots of Proxy settings.** Screenshots and screen recordings of the screen come out black, and it shows blank in the recent-apps view, so your proxy details can't leak that way.

### ✨ New features

* **The app now tells you when your proxy is the problem.** Before, a dead or misconfigured proxy just looked like "Reddit won't load". Now you see a short message explaining what's wrong:
  * **"Can't reach your proxy (host:port)"**: the proxy is down or the address is wrong.
  * **"Can't find your proxy's host name"**: a typo in the host, or DNS trouble.
  * **"Secure (TLS) connection to your proxy failed"**: often a plain HTTP proxy set as HTTPS.
  * **"Your proxy rejected the login"**: a wrong username or password, for HTTP/HTTPS (407) and SOCKS5.
  * **"Your proxy refused the connection… the login may be wrong"**: for proxies that hide a bad login behind a redirect or 404, such as Caddy with probe resistance.

  Each message points you to Proxy settings (long-press the app icon).

  **It's designed not to nag:**
  * it only appears after **3 failures in a row**, and at most **once a minute**;
  * only while the app is **open on screen**;
  * **not when your phone itself has no internet**, so a dead Wi-Fi is never blamed on the proxy;
  * a single website being unreachable through SOCKS5 isn't treated as a proxy problem.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **More accurate error detection for HTTP/HTTPS proxies.** The app now reads your proxy's reply before passing it on, so it can tell a working tunnel from a rejected login. This is what powers the messages above. Traffic still never goes direct when the proxy fails.
* **Clearer advice about patch options.** The README now notes that a login entered as a patch option in Morphe Manager is stored in plain text inside the APK. For a private login, enter it in the app's Proxy settings instead.

### ✅ Tested

Tested with Reddit 2026.40.0 on an Android 15 emulator, watching every connection the app made:

* **Proxy types:**
  * **Plain HTTP proxy mode** (tested for the first time), **HTTPS** and **SOCKS5** all load the feed, with nothing going around the proxy.
  * The same was confirmed again with real test HTTPS and SOCKS5 proxies.
* **Saved password:**
  * the password field never contains it;
  * Test connection works with the saved password;
  * Remove saved password → Save clears it.
* **Screenshots** of Proxy settings come out black.
* **Proxy-down messages:**
  * Each appears exactly once for: a wrong login (407), a Caddy-style rejection (308), and the proxy being down. For example, one message despite 96 rejected attempts.
  * They stay quiet when the phone is offline, and when the app is in the background.
  * Throughout, nothing went direct.

### 📝 Coming later

Encrypting the saved login on the device (Android Keystore) is planned, but needs more research first: what happens when keys are reset, on phones with buggy Keystores, and with backups.

([f555ddc](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/commit/f555ddc798f478128ada4db359d934f50d191aa6))
